name: Additive hypokalemia risk
actions: Review potassium-related risk factors and concurrent medications.
Monitor serum potassium when clinically appropriate.
Use additional caution when other arrhythmia or electrolyte risk factors are present.

rationale: Both drugs can contribute to hypokalemia risk.
Combined effects may increase the likelihood of clinically important potassium depletion.

explanation_template: {A_name} and {B_name} both contribute hypokalemia risk. Combined use may increase potassium depletion and related adverse effects (educational).

references.citation: PD stacking: overlapping hypokalemia risk may increase electrolyte-related adverse effects.
